description: What a pass looks at for the operations of Atoll's own view no pass has taken in, by disk, as for the names a watcher gives: each path an operation touched, on its disk; a folder's on every disk whose catalog holds a folder at either of its paths, as the view renamed or removed it on each; a folder walked below it; a name a deletion or a removal left, deleted; a move's name, on the disk it goes to and on the disk it leaves, neither deleted, as what the move sent to the trash is Atoll's own; or the whole disk past max_names. A name is once on a disk, a folder or deleted when any operation says so, in byte order.

cases.note: a file the view made: its name, on its disk
a file written, given its times, mode or owner: its name
a file deleted: its name, deleted, so that the copy the view sent to the trash is gone
a file renamed: both its names, neither deleted, so that the look finds it at the new one by its inode
a rename onto a name the view presented: both names, neither deleted, as a rename over a file
a folder made: walked below it, on its disk
a symbolic link made: its name
a folder renamed: both names, walked below, on its disk and on each other disk that holds it
a folder removed: deleted and walked below, on its disk and on each disk where it was not empty yet
made, then deleted at one name: once, deleted
a folder made, then a file in it renamed into it: the folder once, a folder
more names than max_names on a disk: a walk of it whole costs less, and the other disk keeps its names
a new file moved to another disk once a write ran out of space: its name on the disk it goes to and on the disk it leaves, neither deleted, as the copy the move sent to the trash is Atoll's own
made on one disk, then moved to another: its name once on each
